prompt: a game like PeeVPee where you pee on your friends

ledger.means: Holding the main button sends a continuous arcing stream that hits friends and pushes them back
Friends play in one game against each other, and the stream is aimed at them
As in the named game: the stream claims surfaces or objects as territory that others can take back, and the score follows territory
As in the named game: a bladder meter empties while peeing and refills from drinks placed in the world
At least two drinks change the stream in different ways
It plays for laughs: a bright, silly look and bodies that react when hit

multiplayer.bar: Two players in one game, in sync: each screen shows the other player as a character where they really are, in the same round or run, and each sees their own score as their own.

policy: No anatomy is modelled: the stream comes from a censor blob or a similar gag
The named game's name and art are not copied; its loop is

control.text: The game includes a working chess board
